columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_of_birth" TEXT NULL, "height_mm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("height_mm" BETWEEN 300 AND 3000), "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("weight_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "length_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("length_unit" IN ('cm', 'in')), "volume_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("volume_unit" IN ('ml', 'fl_oz')), "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("distance_unit" IN ('km', 'mi')), "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_time" TEXT NULL, "workout_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "custom_measurement_types" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "onboarding_completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_weight_g" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_weight_g" > 0), "daily_steps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_steps" >= 0), "daily_water_ml" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_water_ml" >= 0), "sleep_target_min" INTEGER NULL CHECK("sleep_target_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440), "fitness_goals" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weight_g" BETWEEN 1000 AND 700000), "entry_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enqueued_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("entity_table", "entity_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "measurement_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("value_milli" > 0), "unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("unit" IN ('cm', 'percent')), "entry_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("entry_unit" IN ('cm', 'in', 'percent')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "amount_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_ml" BETWEEN 1 AND 5000), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("serving_qty_milli" > 0), "serving_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), "junk_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("junk_category" IS NULL OR "junk_category" IN ('fast_food', 'fried_snacks', 'sweets', 'sugary_drinks', 'packaged_snacks', 'other')), "is_saved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_saved" IN (0, 1)), "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "meal_category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("meal_category" IN ('early_morning', 'breakfast', 'mid_morning', 'lunch', 'evening_snack', 'dinner', 'late_night', 'other')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "has_photo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_photo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "meal_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_logs (id), "food_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity_milli" > 0), "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_mg" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy_kcal_milli" >= 0), "protein_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("protein_mg" >= 0), "carbs_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_mg" >= 0), "fat_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fat_mg" >= 0), "fibre_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fibre_mg" >= 0), "junk_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("junk_category" IS NULL OR "junk_category" IN ('fast_food', 'fried_snacks', 'sweets', 'sugary_drinks', 'packaged_snacks', 'other')), "item_notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_category" TEXT NULL CHECK("meal_category" IS NULL OR "meal_category" IN ('early_morning', 'breakfast', 'mid_morning', 'lunch', 'evening_snack', 'dinner', 'late_night', 'other')), "items" TEXT NOT NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('night', 'nap')), "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("duration_s" BETWEEN 60 AND 86400), "quality" INTEGER NULL CHECK("quality" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "notes" TEXT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_health_checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "energy" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("energy" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "mood" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "stress" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("stress" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "wellness" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("wellness" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX weight_logs_local_date ON weight_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX body_measurements_type_date ON body_measurements (measurement_type, local_date)
CREATE INDEX water_logs_local_date ON water_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX food_items_name ON food_items (name)
CREATE INDEX meal_logs_local_date ON meal_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX meal_food_items_meal ON meal_food_items (meal_log_id)
CREATE INDEX sleep_logs_local_date ON sleep_logs (local_date)
CREATE INDEX daily_health_checkins_local_date ON daily_health_checkins (local_date)
